title: ExpressRoute / VPN Gateway health
description: Monitors hybrid connectivity gateway health, tunnel status, and throughput to prevent outages.
example_prompt: "Check all ExpressRoute circuits and VPN Gateways. Show: (1) circuit/gateway provisioning state, (2) peering state (for ER), (3) tunnel connection status (for VPN), (4) BGP peer state, (5) ingress/egress throughput last 1h vs capacity. Alert on any tunnel down or BGP not established."
